summaries.en: UniDepth-v2-ViTL14 is a monocular depth estimation model that predicts accurate 3D scene geometry from single images, enabling applications like augmented reality and robotics without requiring stereo cameras. It builds on Vision Transformer architecture with specialized training on diverse datasets, achieving robust performance across varied environments and lighting conditions. Developers can integrate it via Hugging Face pipelines for real-time depth mapping or fine-tune on domain-specific imagery to enhance autonomous navigation and 3D reconstruction projects.
summaries.zh: UniDepth-v2-ViTL14 是一种单目深度估计模型，能够从单张图像预测精确的三维场景几何结构，为增强现实和机器人导航等应用提供无需立体相机的空间感知能力。该模型基于视觉Transformer架构，通过在多源数据集上的专门训练，实现了对不同环境和光照条件的鲁棒适应性。开发者可通过Hugging Face管道快速集成，进行实时深度图生成，或针对特定领域图像微调以优化自动驾驶、三维重建等项目的空间理解效果。

summaries.en: wav2vec2-large-xlsr-53-th is a specialized speech recognition model fine-tuned for Thai language, addressing the challenge of accurate automatic transcription in low-resource languages. It builds on Facebook's wav2vec 2.0 architecture using self-supervised learning from raw audio, then applies cross-lingual transfer from XLSR-53's multilingual pretraining to adapt specifically for Thai phonetics and vocabulary. Researchers can use it via Hugging Face Transformers for Thai speech-to-text applications, audio dataset transcription, or as a baseline for developing other Southeast Asian language models.
summaries.zh: wav2vec2-large-xlsr-53-th 是专为泰语优化的语音识别模型，解决了低资源语言自动转录准确性的难题。该模型基于 Facebook 的 wav2vec 2.0 架构，通过自监督学习从原始音频中提取特征，并利用 XLSR-53 的多语言预训练进行跨语言迁移，专门适配泰语的语音特点和词汇体系。开发者可通过 Hugging Face Transformers 快速部署该模型，用于泰语语音转文字、音频数据集标注，或作为开发其他东南亚语言模型的基准参考，为多语言语音技术研究提供实用工具。
